cn_cover_label: 原型已在 DROID 等 3 个公开真实数据集上跑通，发现卡死、越限与字段说明错误
cn_demo_title: 原型实测：检出 90% 注入错误，纯规则基线只有 40%
cn_demo_sub: 内部原型 · 合成数据：200 条基于样本 109 几何生成的抓放轨迹，7 类错误各 10 条；干净样本 0 误拒，有效失败 10/10 保留
cn_tamper: 改一个物体标签、把一个时间戳挪 1 毫秒、或改一个计数，验签即失败；还原后通过。本张验收单覆盖 147 条（137 通过、10 修复），另有 53 条拒收。
cn_demo_note: 内部原型、合成数据、每类 n = 10，注入器与引擎出自同一团队。引擎漏检 7 条：6 条错标为尺寸相近的类别（杯子→花瓶 / 水果 / 耳机），1 条轻微下陷。下一步：真实数据上由第三方复现。
cn_selfcheck: 30 条规则：24 条用 Z3 在 14 帧有界模型上证明可同时满足（一条成功、一条滑落）；其中 9 条在合成数据上逐条由 Z3 判定；6 条为数值检查。真实数据模式目前只跑数值检查。
cn_proto_bullets: 真实数据：DROID、Jaco Play、NYU ROT 共 41 条轨迹、3,870 帧；在 DROID 中发现机械臂卡死、关节越限、动作字段说明与数值不符
合成基准（含噪声）：检出 92%、0 误拒，与我们的强基线持平；细节优势基线约一天可追平，不作壁垒
每条真实数据集都签发了验收单，离线验签通过；改任一字段即失败
一条命令复现全部结果（run_v2.py）
us_cover_label: checked across DROID and two other public datasets; found a stuck arm, an over-limit joint, a mis-documented field
us_demo_title: The prototype catches 90% of injected errors; rules alone catch 40%
us_demo_sub: Internal, synthetic: 200 pick-and-place episodes seeded from real scan geometry; 7 error classes, 10 each; 0 false rejects; 10/10 valid failures kept
us_tamper: Change one label, shift one timestamp by 1 ms, or edit one count: verification fails. Restore the files: it passes. This passport covers 147 accepted episodes (137 pass, 10 repaired); 53 were rejected.
us_demo_note: Internal prototype, synthetic data, n = 10 per class; the same team wrote the injector and the engine. Misses: 6 relabels to similar-sized classes, 1 slight sink. Next: third-party rerun on real data.
us_selfcheck: 30 rules: 24 proven jointly consistent with Z3 on a bounded 14-frame model (one success, one slip); 9 are decided by Z3 per episode on synthetic data; 6 are numeric. Real-data mode runs numeric checks only today.
us_proto_bullets: Real data: 41 episodes, 3,870 frames from DROID, Jaco Play and NYU ROT; in DROID it found a stuck arm, an over-limit joint and a mis-documented action field
Noisy synthetic benchmark: 92% recall, 0 false rejects; ties our own strong baseline, which could close the remaining detail gaps in about a day
A signed passport for every real dataset, verified offline; change any field and it fails
